headword: {懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}

definitions.explanation: A small portable timepiece carried in a pocket, typically on a chain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received my grandfather's pocket watch.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I have a gold pocket watch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{懐中時計|かいちゅうどけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}して→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: He took out a pocket watch from his pocket and checked the time.

notes:
A small clock carried in a pocket, typically attached to a chain. A compound of ⟦{懐中|かいちゅう}→懐中：22597_kaichuu⟧ (in one's pocket; on one's person) and {時計|どけい} (clock/watch). Although no longer a common everyday item, pocket watches appear frequently in literature, period dramas, and as collector's items.
